title: PPG UX — File I/O, Auto-Detect, Diff Viewer, History, Clipboard
description: Close the UX gaps in PostProcessorGeneratorPage that prevent production use. Add file upload/download (drag-drop NC files), clipboard copy, machine auto-detection from G-code syntax, before/after diff viewer, and session history exposure. Backend has ppgHistory but UI has no access.

data: client.ts (API functions: ppgGenerate, ppgValidate, ppgCompare, ppgControllers, ppgOperations)

forge_triple.protective_hook: ppg-ux-quality — warns if PPG page edits remove file I/O or clipboard functionality
forge_triple.mcp_action: prism_product ppg_detect_controller — auto-detect controller from G-code
forge_triple.skill: /ppg-detect — paste G-code and auto-detect the CNC controller family

units.title: Add file upload (drag-drop) and download to PostProcessorGeneratorPage
steps: Add file upload input: <input type='file' accept='.nc,.gcode,.ngc,.tap,.mpf,.spf,.h' />
Add drag-drop zone around the G-code textarea with visual feedback
On file load: read as text, populate gcodeInput state
Add download button: generate Blob from output G-code, trigger browser download as .nc file
File naming: original_filename_PRISM_optimized.nc
Show file size and line count in UI
exit_conditions: Drag-drop an NC file loads it into the editor
Download button produces a valid .nc file
File round-trip: upload → optimize → download produces valid G-code

units.title: Add clipboard copy button + machine auto-detect from G-code
steps: Add copy-to-clipboard button next to output G-code area
Use navigator.clipboard.writeText() with visual feedback (checkmark animation)
Add auto-detect controller: parse first 20 lines of G-code for syntax markers:
Fanuc: O0001, G90 G21, M98 P, parentheses comments
Siemens: ;$PATH=, CYCLE800, DEF INT, semicolon comments
Heidenhain: BEGIN PGM, BLK FORM, CYCL DEF, ~ continuation
Haas: O00001, G65 P, T M06 no space, percent sign header
Mazak: G10 L2, Mazak-specific M codes
When auto-detected, pre-select the controller dropdown
Show confidence: 'Detected: Fanuc 31i (high confidence)'
exit_conditions: Copy button copies G-code to clipboard
Unknown syntax shows 'Could not auto-detect' without error

units.title: Add before/after diff viewer for optimization comparison
steps: Create DiffViewer component: side-by-side view of original vs optimized G-code
Highlight changed lines (S/F values that differ)
Show per-line annotations: why the feed changed (chip thinning, corner, wear, etc.)
Summary stats at top: lines changed, avg feed delta %, cycle time delta
Toggle between unified diff and side-by-side views
exit_conditions: Diff viewer shows changed lines highlighted

units.title: Expose session history to UI from backend ppgHistory
steps: Backend: expose GET /api/v1/ppg/history endpoint (ppgHistory already tracked in ProductEngine)
Frontend: add API function ppgHistory() in client.ts
UI: add history panel showing last 20 processed programs
Each entry: timestamp, controller, line count, cycle time delta, status
Click to reload: re-populates gcodeInput with that program's input
Add undo: revert to previous version from history

exit_gate: File upload/download, clipboard copy, auto-detect, diff viewer, and history all working. PPG page is production-ready for end users. /prism-review passed.
test_results: Build: 0 TS errors. All 4 PPG UX features implemented with lightsaber LED borders.
